content_units: You have a credible path into   entry-level HR in Dublin   because your retail management background already covers core people operations: hiring, onboarding, scheduling, employee relations, training, and payroll coordination. With a   salary floor of €38,000  , the best-fit target is likely   HR Coordinator / People Operations Coordinator / Talent Acquisition Coordinator   roles at larger employers, retail head offices, hospitality groups, healthcare providers, logistics firms, and multinationals with structured HR teams.
-   Strengths already proven:   staff supervision, high-volume hiring, conflict handling, rota/workforce planning, training, payroll liaison
-   Best transition angle:   position yourself as an   operations-to-people   candidate, not as someone “starting from zero”
-   Most realistic salary path:   aim for roles with admin + employee lifecycle ownership rather than purely junior office support
Job Title   Why it fits your background   Likely Dublin fit vs €38k floor   What to highlight
HR Coordinator   Strong match for onboarding, employee records, payroll support, policy admin     Strong     hiring support, onboarding, documentation accuracy, staff support
People Operations Coordinator   Modern HR admin role with employee lifecycle focus     Strong     employee experience, scheduling complexity, process improvement, training

Talent Acquisition Coordinator   Good fit if you handled seasonal hiring and interviews     Moderate to Strong     volume recruitment, candidate screening, interview scheduling, employer-facing communication
HR Administrator   Common entry route into HR teams     Moderate     contracts/admin, HR systems, payroll coordination, confidentiality
Learning & Development Coordinator   Fits training and onboarding experience     Moderate     new starter training, coaching, SOPs, performance support

1) HR Coordinator   and   2) People Operations Coordinator   are your strongest targets because they align best with your current experience and are more likely than basic HR admin posts to meet your salary floor.
Option 1:   HR Coordinator     Best balance of entry accessibility and salary potential   Employee lifecycle support
Option 2:   People Operations Coordinator     Strong match for operational leadership + people processes   Modern HR pathway
Option 3:   Talent Acquisition Coordinator     Best if you want a recruitment-led entry into HR   High-volume hiring relevance
Option 4:   HR Administrator     Good fallback route if role includes payroll/onboarding exposure   Broad access point
Option 5:   Learning & Development Coordinator     Useful if you enjoy coaching and training delivery   Training-focused track
Transferable Skills to Emphasize in Applications
-   Recruitment support:   hired seasonal workers, screened candidates, coordinated interviews, supported fast-volume staffing needs
-   Onboarding:   trained new starters, explained procedures, helped employees become productive quickly
-   Employee relations:   resolved workplace conflict, handled sensitive issues, supported fair treatment and team morale
-   Workforce planning:   built schedules/rotas, managed staffing coverage, responded to absence and business demand
-   Payroll coordination:   checked hours, liaised on pay queries, supported accurate payroll inputs
-   Performance support:   coached team members, gave feedback, improved standards and accountability
-   Policy/process compliance:   enforced procedures, maintained consistency, handled confidential staff matters
-   Stakeholder communication:   balanced employee needs with business goals, worked with store leadership and support teams
-   Training delivery:   taught systems/processes, upskilled new staff, reinforced service and compliance standards
-   HR systems readiness:   even if not from formal HRIS use, show comfort with spreadsheets, rostering systems, reports, and admin accuracy
- “Managed end-to-end onboarding for new retail hires during peak recruitment periods.”
- “Supported high-volume hiring and workforce planning to maintain staffing levels.”
- “Handled employee relations matters including conflict resolution and attendance issues.”
- “Coordinated payroll inputs, scheduling, and training records with strong attention to accuracy.”
- “Delivered new starter coaching and process training to improve ramp-up speed and team performance.”
Your goal is to become interview-ready for HR coordinator-level roles within 3 months, while showing clear knowledge of Irish employment basics and HR administration.

Days 1-30   Reframe your experience for HR   Rewrite CV for HR; update LinkedIn headline; map retail tasks to HR terms; collect 4-6 quantified examples; review Irish HR fundamentals   HR-targeted CV + LinkedIn + achievement stories

Days 31-60   Build technical HR credibility   Learn recruitment workflow, onboarding docs, HR admin, payroll basics, absence/leave tracking, Excel reporting; study Irish employment rights at a practical level   Short HR skills portfolio + interview answers

Days 61-90   Convert learning into interviews   Apply selectively to 20-30 strong-fit roles; tailor CV per title; practice competency interviews; prepare salary script around €38k floor; network with Dublin HR recruiters   Interview-ready application pipeline
- Change your CV headline to something like:   Retail Operations Leader transitioning into HR / People Operations
- reduction in rota gaps / overtime / turnover if known
-   Irish employment basics  : contracts, probation, working time, leave, documentation
-   Recruitment operations  : candidate coordination, interview logistics, offer/admin steps
-   HR administration  : personnel files, contracts, employee letters, records
-   Payroll support  : timesheets, overtime inputs, pay query escalation
-   Excel  : sorting, lookups, trackers, absence logs, simple dashboards
- Target employers where your retail background is a direct advantage:
- if a role is lower but offers direct HR progression, treat it as a trade-off only if the experience gain is exceptional
- companies where   multi-site staffing   and   high-volume hiring   matter
- vacancies asking for   employee relations, onboarding, recruitment admin, payroll liaison, and training support
“I’m moving from people-heavy retail operations into HR, bringing six years of hands-on experience in hiring, onboarding, scheduling, employee support, training, and payroll coordination.”
